source: Maddison Project Database 2023 (Bolt & van Zanden 2024), GDP per capita, 2011 international $ (PPP)
note: rank = rank of Argentina by GDPpc among all countries with GDPpc data that year in MPD2023 'Full data'. rankPop1M excludes countries whose MPD2023 population is < 1 million that year (pop column is in thousands; where pop is missing for a year it is linearly interpolated between the nearest available MPD years, or held at the nearest value at the edges); excludedPop1M lists them.
